title: Higher Education Act – HEA (Luật Giáo dục Đại học)

versions.text:
Higher Education Act (HEA) – 20 USC §1001 et seq.
Title I: General provisions. Title II: Teacher quality. Title IV: Student assistance – Pell Grants (max $7,395/năm 2024-25), Federal Direct Loans (subsidized/unsubsidized), PLUS Loans, Federal Work-Study. Income-Driven Repayment (IDR): SAVE, IBR, PAYE, ICR. Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF): 120 payments.
